purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system - drug/medication information (Yakujyo) registration and management screen component N21
purpose.summary: This program implements the medication/drug information settings screen (N21) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles initialization, screen transitions, CRUD operations (search, register, delete, copy, list) for drug/medication master data. It is a subprogram called via the ORCA MCP framework with SPA (scratchpad area) and screen area linkage.

notable_features: COPY-heavy design with 27 COPY statements for shared data structures
LINKAGE SECTION with MCP/SPA/LINKAREA pattern (ORCA framework)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments and data literals (latin-1 decoded)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT/MCP-WIDGET for GUI event dispatch
File existence check and file delete subprogram calls
Kana search table with full-width katakana literals
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP DB access layer
27 CALL statements to ORCA framework subprograms
175 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments and string literals. The ORCGN21 program-id and filename match. This is clearly part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system, a well-known production GnuCOBOL application used in Japanese medical clinics.
